title: Audience-Bound Persistent Memory: Authorization Across the Memory Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2609.36373v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A personal language agent that acts for its owner across private and shared conversations can learn a fact from one audience and later place it in the context it assembles for another. We study authorization before context across the whole memory lifecycle. Each memory item carries the audience present when it was recorded; derived items are partitioned by audience, receive the intersection of their sources' audiences, or are suppressed; an audience widens only by an explicit, object-specific grant; and an item enters a model attempt only when every current viewer belongs to one of its authorized audiences, with unresolved viewers failing closed to public-only. Under explicit identity, provenance and complete-mediation assumptions, this admission is sound and policy-complete on the exact assembled context, enforced by exclusion rather than by model behavior. translated_title: 受众绑定的持久记忆：贯穿记忆生命周期的授权
translated_abstract: 一个代表其所有者在私密与共享对话中行动的个人语言代理，可能会从某一受众处获知一个事实，之后却将其放入为另一受众组装的上下文中。我们研究了贯穿整个记忆生命周期、先于上下文构建的授权问题。每个记忆条目都携带其被记录时在场的受众信息；派生条目按受众进行分区、继承其来源受众的交集，或被抑制；受众范围的扩大只能通过明确的、针对特定对象的授权来实现；只有当每个当前查看者都属于该条目的某一授权受众时，该条目才会进入模型尝试，对于身份无法确认的查看者，则按故障关闭原则默认其仅可见公开内容。在明确的身份、来源与完全中介假设下，这种准入机制在精确组装的上下文上是可靠且策略完备的，通过排除机制而非依赖模型行为来执行。我们在两种独立持久化的参考架构中实现了该机制，其中一种是扁平存储架构（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种受众绑定的持久记忆授权机制，让每条记忆携带记录时的受众标签、派生记忆继承来源受众的交集，仅当所有当前查看者均属于授权受众时记忆才进入模型上下文，从而通过排除机制而非模型行为，在记忆全生命周期实现可靠且策略完备的跨受众信息隔离。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an audience-bound authorization mechanism for persistent memory, where each memory item carries its recording audience, derived items inherit the intersection of their sources' audiences, and items enter the model context only when every current viewer belongs to an authorized audience—enforced by exclusion rather than model behavior, achieving sound and policy-complete access control across the entire memory lifecycle.
